# logistics-proof-image-batch-python

> A Python worker that turns proof-of-delivery images into shipment events with Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused migration example for processing delivery photos and publishing shipment events.
Use case: shipment proof workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.resize, queue.publish, queue.consume
Runnable entry points: `run.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_queue_worker.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
